checks.opening: Freelancers sending client work: AI can cross roles, so a draft can slip through.
If AI helps with client messages, invoices, or scheduling, the risky part is the handoff.
If you use AI to help with client work, the main problem is usually not the first draft.
If AI will touch client messages, invoices, or scheduling, the useful question is not whether it can do it.
